request.userText: Plan recovery of the orders dataset into an isolated validation destination using a retained recovery point that meets the stated recovery objective. Determine source, destination, available recovery material and tool constraints from the inventory. Preserve the production dataset and retained backups. Verify recovered data before any consumer can use it, and define how an unsuccessful recovery is contained. Never deprovision resources or restore into production-orders. Keep unresolved recovery-point suitability and destructive choices explicit.

constraints: Production data and retained backups must remain unchanged.
No deprovisioning and no restore into production-orders.
Consumer access requires verification of the isolated restored data; no live recovery has been performed.

successCriteria.description: The selected recovery material can meet the requested point-in-time and data-integrity objectives, with unsupported guarantees explicit.
The destination is independently identified and production and retained backup material remain protected.
Consumers cannot use the recovered data before verification; a failed recovery remains isolated.
Data producers, consumers and failure handling use the same intended recovery material without invented values.

retention/points.json.coverage: Retained export only; restore compatibility still requires verification

unsupportedGuarantees: Application consistency without an application-level check
